title: Vanishing coefficient outside the dependence set
statement: Let $Ω$ be a finite nonempty set with probability measure $π$, and let $ι$ be a finite nonempty index set. Suppose $B$ is a basis of real-valued functions on $Ω$ that is orthonormal for the $π$-weighted inner product and has a distinguished index $0_B$ whose basis function is constantly one. For $n\ge 0$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates and let $f:Ω^n\to\mathbb R$ depend only on the coordinates in $J$, meaning that inputs agreeing on $J$ have the same value under $f$. If a multi-index $a\inι^n$ has a nonconstant coordinate outside $J$, then the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $a$ is zero.
